blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Observed 2026-10-02T22:43:49.516688+00:00 at ethereum block 26107702 (hash 0x292b4ed6cca79fa476bc17c9ef12dd938dbbf67f4a61564c2fe8f897e07390e6). Native totalSupply 88558225018782413763816976 (18 decimals), asset 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7 (6 decimals), totalAssets 89911293130474, convertToAssets(10^18) 1015278. One-share redeem from actual holder 0x1601843c5e9bc251a3272907010afa41fa18347e returned 1015278 asset base units via eth_call at that same block; no transaction broadcast. Underlying USDT retains its issuer freeze authority; the pinned parent authority getter returned 0x000000000000000000000000c6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828. No direct receipt-transfer blacklist is asserted. Morpho V2 send/receive share gates are abdicated; send-assets deposit-gate configuration remains a separate timelocked control; withdrawals use the permanently abdicated sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate. Correction reverified from exact enter()/exit() source and pinned gate getters: sendAssetsGate controls deposits through canSendAssets(msg.sender), not withdrawals. Withdrawals check sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate; both were zero and both setters permanently abdicated at block 26107702. Actual-holder transfer of 1e18 shares returned true. Available liquidity and underlying USDT issuer controls can still prevent exit.
